mode.description: Running mode: live, dump, drain, or stat.

interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Required for live and dump modes.

snaplen.description: Maximum length of captured raw packet in bytes.

bsize.description: Size of the operating system capture buffer in MBytes.

promisc.description: Put the capturing interface into promiscuous mode.

direction.description: Direction for which packets will be captured (in, out, inout).

modules.description: List of analysis modules to load. Each item is a flat object with 'path' and optional 'options'. If empty, default trace behavior applies if trace=true or no modules passed.

input_file.description: Input file path for stat mode.

output_file.description: Output file path for dump mode.

command.description: Shell command to execute for each dumped file.

dump_size.description: Size of the dumping file portion in MBytes. 0 means no limit.

msg_header.description: Truncate RPC messages to this limit in bytes before passing to analysis module.

qcapacity.description: Initial capacity of the queue with RPC messages.

trace.description: Print collected NFSv3 or NFSv4 procedures.

drop_root_user.description: Username to drop root privileges to after opening capture device.
